newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dawson buy is reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dawson buy is reiterated.

text.p: -- Jefferies & Co reiterated its "buy" recommendation on oil services company Dawson Production Services Inc and said its 12-month price target on the stock is $25.

-- "As a result of the acquisition of Pride's domestic well servicing operations, Dawson's fleet accounts for approximately 10 percent of all domestic onshore rig workovers, with market share of over 22 percent in south and east Texas, 21 percent in California, and 11 percent in west Texas," Jefferies said.
-- Jefferies said Dawson is undervalued relative to its peer group.
